'''Spudwee''' was was one of the [[Twi'lek freedom fighters/Legends|Twi'lek freedom fighters]] that were led by [[Cham Syndulla/Legends|Cham Syndulla]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Spudwee was one of the Twi'leks that were massacred by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] forces during the initial stages of the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]]. After their [[Death/Legends|death]], Spudwee was among the freedom fighters that were buried in a graveyard on [[Ryloth/Legends|their homeworld]]. Spudwee's name was inscribed in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] on the gravestone.
